summary: This script sets up a ripgrep configuration file path, loads custom ZSH functions from a directory, and creates convenient shortcut aliases for searching specific file types with ripgrep (a fast text search tool). It's basically building a personalized search environment with type-specific commands.

explanations.1: This sets an environment variable telling ripgrep where to find its configuration file, so it will automatically load your custom settings whenever you run ripgrep.
explanations.5: This loop looks for all files ending in .zsh inside the ~/.zsh/fns/ directory and will process each one.
explanations.6: The 'source' command loads and runs each function file, making all the custom functions inside them available to use in your shell session.
